text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Farming work had begun at the academy. Its effects were gradually showing in the students' everyday lives as well.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
"Everyone! Thanks for watching the stream!
Today, we'll be doing it together with a guest!"

text_block_list.name: Comment
text_block_list.text:
"A guest?" "It's Jungle Pocket-san!"
"That might be pretty rare...!"

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Huh? Shut up. Who cares anyway.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
I just watched your video
and thought it'd be nice to try once in a while.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Yeah, yeah! Thank you~! Let's get right into making another easy, delicious dish today~!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Wait, seriously? Pokke's doing a cooking stream? Wild.
Can she even pull that off~?

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
"Ooh, looks tasty!
See? Cooking's pretty easy, isn't it?"

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
"...Wait, you're already done?
Hmph..."

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
"...No way, I can do it too!
I'm gonna pull it off today!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Then, on another day—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Mirako-san, how does it taste?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Nom nom!
There's no way something made in three steps could taste this good~!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"Like, seriously,
to come up with such an easy-peasy lazy recipe...
Isn't Akebono-chan... kinda super-duper amazing?"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe~. I was so happy that Miracle-san asked me!
I got all fired up and came up with about 30 recipes~!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Th-Thirty... Th-That much... !?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
If everyone's eating yummy food,
I can give it my all no matter what!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Everyone! If you have recipes you want me to try,
kitchen gadgets you're curious about, or anything cooking-related,
send it on in~!

text_block_list.name: Comment
text_block_list.text:
"Ehh! What about some rare dishes?"
"How about urban legend stuff?"
"Ah! In that case, there's this story I heard the other day—"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: W-Whaaaaat!?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: T-T-T-Trainer-saaaan!!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Huff, puff... U-Um, listen!
I just heard something incredible!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Let's go search for the “Legendary Kitchen Knife”!!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! I was doing a cooking stream today!
And then, a viewer said—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Colony of Poisonous Plants

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: "The Foggy Valley"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: "The cave guarded by the sentinel—"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: "Deep inside lies the supreme kitchen knife, capable of slicing effortlessly through anything."

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: ...She told me that rumor!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
To be honest, it's a pretty suspicious story.
However—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
I want to cook...
much, much tastier food!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Everyone's been taking an interest in cooking lately,
and it makes me so genuinely happy!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Seeing everyone so happy and saying it's delicious
makes me super duper glad! That's why—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
"I want to learn how to cook even tastier food!
I want to fill everyone's bellies even more!"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Because that's super buono!
choice_data_list: ...And for that, you need a kitchen knife?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! A knife's sharpness affects how good the food tastes, too!
Above all, I'm really curious!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Hishi Akebono's eyes were breathtakingly serious.
Even if it was just a strange rumor,
she seemed to have found her own hope in it.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
!!!!
Yeah! I'll definitely track it down!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: So I'll make a huge, delicious feast for you~~!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Somehow managing to stop Hishi Akebono,
who looked ready to take off at a moment's notice...
we began preparing for our journey to find the kitchen knife.
